d:
Priy vyuar,
Aaj se do. vikas divyakirti ne 'konsept tok siriz' ke antargat ethiks vishay (samany adhyayan pepar-4) par ek shrrinkhla shuru ki hai jismen ethiks ke pathyakram se juri kuchh uljhi huee avdharnaon ko spasht kiya jaega.
Aaj ham is shrrinkhla ki pahli kari aapke sath sheyar kar rahe hain jismen ethiks aur morailiti shabdon ka antar spasht kiya gaya hai. rozmarra ke jivan ke udaharnon ko aadhar banakar is vidiyo men spasht kiya gaya hai ki paryayvachi pratit hone vale in shabdon (ethiks tatha morailiti) men kya antar hai aur kis bindu par vah antar samapt ho jata hai.
